她选了一条小巷，这里有两个丧尸。

将白虎放到背包里，站到巷子中，使用异能。

她没事就喜欢用异能变花，此时她能一次性变三朵花出来，当黑色小花在她指尖绽放，那两个丧尸像是嗅到了什么，转身朝着时笙看过来。

可是和他们看到人类表现出来的那种兴奋不同，此时的他们有些萎靡，又有些迷茫。

时笙试着往前面走了几步，两只丧尸没有任何动静，依旧维持着原样站在那里。

直到时笙靠近他们两米，他们都没有任何动静。

我去，这异能叼爆了啊！

“嗬嗬！”丧尸忽然动了，张牙舞爪的朝着时笙扑过来。

时笙一惊，转身就跑。

妈的，异能用光了！

余良以为那个少女不会回来了，谁知道没多久，他就看到少女一阵风似的从街角跑过来，踩着楼下的车，麻溜的爬上了阳台。

“你在这里做什么？”看到余良，时笙皱了眉。

“我……我守夜。”

“阳台归我，别靠近这里。”

末世最可怕的是什么？

是人心。

她可没心情去应付这些人，末世杀人不犯法，这些人要是靠自己太近，指不定她什么时候就要开始报社了。

余良离开后，时笙又抱着猫躺到摇椅上，慢慢的恢复异能。

这异能能让丧尸萎靡，甚至是无视她，在末世，这异能才是杀人越货必备。

你想想，几十万丧尸大军中，你能在里面自由的行走，那场面，得多拉风。

想想还是蛮激动的。

只不过距离和范围还得实验之后才能知道。

时笙叹口气，就她这被抢了金手指的原女主，要想逆袭，难啊！

翌日，余良的人在讨论该往哪里走，时笙依旧躺在阳台的椅子上，那悠闲懒散的模样，让余静气得牙痒痒。

“我们想在收集一些物资，然后出城，你去吗？”余良从屋子里走出来，态度颇好的问她。

“不去。”

She chose an alley where there were two zombies.

Put the white tiger in the backpack, stand in the alley, and use the power.

She likes to use her powers to turn into flowers when she has nothing to do. At this time, she can turn into three flowers at once. When the black flowers bloomed at her fingertips, the two zombies seemed to smell something and turned to look at Shi Sheng.

But unlike the excitement they felt when they saw humans, they were a little sluggish and confused at this time.

Shi Sheng tried to take a few steps forward, but the two zombies made no movement and still stood there as they were.

They didn't make any movement until Shi Sheng came within two meters of them.

Go ahead, this superpower is amazing!

"Ho ho!" The zombie suddenly moved and rushed towards Shi Sheng with its teeth and claws open.

Shi Sheng was startled, turned around and ran away.

Damn, I ran out of powers!

Yu Liang thought that the girl would not come back, but not long after, he saw the girl running from the corner of the street like a gust of wind, stepping on the car downstairs, and climbing up to the balcony.

"What are you doing here?" Shi Sheng frowned when he saw Yu Liang.

"I...I'm keeping watch."

"The balcony belongs to me, don't come near it."

What is the scariest thing about the end of the world?

It's the human heart.

She was in no mood to deal with these people. It was not illegal to kill people in the last days. If these people got too close to her, she might start a newspaper agency at some point.

After Yu Liang left, Shi Sheng hugged the cat and lay on the rocking chair, slowly regaining his powers.

This ability can make zombies languish or even ignore her. In the end of the world, this ability is necessary for killing and stealing.

Think about it, you can walk freely among an army of hundreds of thousands of zombies. It would be a very cool scene.

It's quite exciting to think about it.

It's just that the distance and range can only be known after experiments.

Shi Sheng sighed, it would be difficult for her, the original heroine who had been robbed of her golden finger, to counterattack!

The next day, Yu Liang's people were discussing where to go. Shi Sheng was still lying on the chair on the balcony, with such a leisurely and lazy look that made Yu Jing angry.

"We want to collect some supplies and then leave the city, will you go?" Yu Liang walked out of the house and asked her in a good manner.

"Not going."
